text:
maria: Heads-up — I want to propose trimming some SIEM retention tiers to reduce monthly costs. Thinking: debug logs 30d, app logs 90d, audit/logins 365d in long-term archive. Need input on forensic impact, RBAC for ad-hoc queries, and KMS/archival options.

devin: curious — what's the expected $/month saving if we do 30/90/365?

maria: ballpark $18k/mo for raw ingest and storage across prod+staging if we push debug down to 30d. Biggest wins are removing verbose debug from prod exports.

ben: :thinking_face: Forensics question — if an incident needs deeper replay >30d, do we have a plan? cold-archive vs full export?

maria: idea is to write selective cold-archive for flagged incidents only. We keep user-auth/audit events in hot store for 365d; everything else goes to cheaper encrypted bucket with KMS for 2y if compliance asks.

alex: legal: we have a standing requirement to keep auth/audit trails for 2 years for certain contracts. Any change must be opt-out per customer. We need mapping of which customers require longer retention.

devin: technically feasible — we can route per-customer logs with a tag and apply lifecycle. For the cold-archive, I'd prefer using envelope encryption with our KMS key alias `alias/sec-archive` and object lock for WORM when required. Example lifecycle snippet I used in testing:```{
  "Rules": [
    {"ID":"debug-short","Filter":{"Prefix":"prod/debug/"},"Status":"Enabled","Expiration":{"Days":30}},
    {"ID":"app-90","Filter":{"Prefix":"prod/app/"},"Status":"Enabled","Expiration":{"Days":90}},
    {"ID":"audit-archive","Filter":{"Prefix":"prod/audit/"},"Status":"Enabled","Transition":{"Days":365,"StorageClass":"GLACIER"}}  
  ]
}```

sec-bot: note: creating RFC draft in #eng-docs for proposed retention change (rfc-4457).

sara: From oncall POV — 30d debug hurts root-cause for slow-burn incidents. Can we keep 90d for services with >1000 error/day or make debug retention conditional on error rate?

maria: good call. proposal update: debug 30d default, 90d conditional if error-rate > threshold or active incident tag. We'll auto-promote buckets to 90d for 7 days when a CI is opened.

ben: RBAC: we should avoid broad exports. Proposal: create `siem-analyst` role that has query/view only, `siem-exporter` role for exports with 2-person approval and `forensics` role for temporary rehydration of archives. Exports require a ticket and justification.

devin: implemented as IAM perms + a middleware service that enforces approvals. We can log approvals in audit trail. I'll draft perms: `siem:Query`, `siem:ReadResults`, `siem:ExportRequest` and a short TTL for `forensics` creds.

alex: also ensure any export touching PII fields goes through DLP masking. Compliance will need exported-delivery receipts.

maria: action items: 1) dev: draft lifecycle + KMS envelope plan (devin) 2) sec: RBAC roles + approval flow (ben) 3) oncall: define conditional debug promotion rules (sara) 4) legal: list customers with 2y retention needs (alex). I'll compile RFC and list tickets.

devin: filing ticket INFRA-3291 for lifecycle + KMS.

ben: filing ticket SEC-2104 for RBAC + export workflow.

sara: filing ticket ONCALL-77 for conditional retention triggers.

maria: thanks all, please add notes to the RFC thread. We'll sync in next eng-security sync. :thumbsup:
